description: Daily long-only A/B/C comparison of staircase, ATR, and hybrid medium-term virtual portfolios. No broker positions, stop orders, or executions are represented.

targets.rawSql: SELECT portfolio.name, portfolio.strategy, portfolio.initial_cash + COALESCE(sum(position.net_pnl) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'closed'), 0) AS realized_equity, count(position.id) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'open') AS open_positions, count(position.id) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'closed') AS closed_positions, count(position.id) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'closed' AND position.net_pnl > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(count(position.id) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'closed'), 0) AS win_rate, avg(position.net_return_pct) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'closed') AS avg_net_return, COALESCE(sum(position.net_pnl) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'closed'), 0) AS realized_pnl, COALESCE(sum(position.notional) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'open'), 0) AS open_notional FROM medium_term_paper_portfolios portfolio LEFT JOIN medium_term_paper_positions position ON position.portfolio_name = portfolio.name WHERE portfolio.name IN (${portfolio:sqlstring}) GROUP BY portfolio.name, portfolio.strategy, portfolio.initial_cash ORDER BY portfolio.strategy

SELECT exit_date::timestamp AS time, sum(net_pnl) OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_name ORDER BY exit_date, id)::double precision AS value, portfolio_name AS metric FROM medium_term_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_date::timestamp) AND portfolio_name IN (${portfolio:sqlstring}) ORDER BY exit_date ASC, id ASC

WITH curve AS (SELECT id, portfolio_name, exit_date, sum(net_pnl) OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_name ORDER BY exit_date, id) AS cumulative_pnl FROM medium_term_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed'), drawdown AS (SELECT id, portfolio_name, exit_date, cumulative_pnl - max(cumulative_pnl) OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_name ORDER BY exit_date, id) AS value FROM curve) SELECT exit_date::timestamp AS time, value::double precision, portfolio_name AS metric FROM drawdown WHERE $__timeFilter(exit_date::timestamp) AND portfolio_name IN (${portfolio:sqlstring}) ORDER BY exit_date ASC, id ASC

SELECT position.entry_date, position.portfolio_name, position.ticker, position.strategy, position.entry_price, latest.close AS latest_close, (latest.close / position.entry_price - 1) AS unrealized_return, position.current_stop, (position.current_stop / position.entry_price - 1) AS locked_return, position.highest_close, position.held_sessions, position.notional FROM medium_term_paper_positions position LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT close FROM moex_market_history WHERE secid = position.ticker AND close IS NOT NULL ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) latest ON true WHERE position.status = 'open' AND position.portfolio_name IN (${portfolio:sqlstring}) ORDER BY position.entry_date DESC, position.ticker

SELECT exit_date, portfolio_name, ticker, strategy, entry_date, entry_price, exit_price, exit_reason, held_sessions, gross_return_pct, net_return_pct, costs, net_pnl FROM medium_term_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND portfolio_name IN (${portfolio:sqlstring}) ORDER BY exit_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 150

SELECT history.trade_date, position.portfolio_name, position.ticker, position.strategy, history.previous_stop, history.new_stop, history.highest_close, history.reason FROM medium_term_stop_history history JOIN medium_term_paper_positions position ON position.id = history.position_id WHERE position.portfolio_name IN (${portfolio:sqlstring}) ORDER BY history.trade_date DESC, history.id DESC LIMIT 150

SELECT portfolio_name, reason, count(*) AS decisions, max(signal_date) AS latest_signal_date FROM medium_term_paper_decisions WHERE decision = 'skip' AND portfolio_name IN (${portfolio:sqlstring}) GROUP BY portfolio_name, reason ORDER BY decisions DESC

SELECT portfolio_name, ticker, exit_reason, count(*) AS closed_positions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_pnl > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS win_rate, avg(net_return_pct) AS avg_net_return, sum(net_pnl) AS net_pnl FROM medium_term_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND portfolio_name IN (${portfolio:sqlstring}) GROUP BY portfolio_name, ticker, exit_reason ORDER BY net_pnl DESC
